title: PrismCrawl Google Maps Reviews API input
description: Get full Google Maps reviews for any place, or all reviews written by a Google contributor, through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Fetch the reviews of one place (in relevance order), or the reviews written by one Google Maps contributor (newest first, covering their first 200 reviews).

id.title: Place ID or contributor ID
id.description: For a place, the place_id from Google Maps search results (for example from the PrismCrawl Google Maps Places Actor), not the data_id. For a contributor, the numeric ID in their Google Maps contributor profile URL.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (one page of reviews each). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

limit.title: Reviews per page
limit.description: Maximum reviews per page: up to 10 for a place, up to 50 for a contributor. Google may return fewer.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country or storefront code, such as us or gb.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code supported by the provider, such as en.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
